<div class="spoiler metadata darkbackground1" style="color:#090">'''Non-canon information ends here.'''</div><noinclude>

==Usage==
Place <code>{{Tl|Noncanonstart}}</code> at the beginning of a segment of non-canon material, and <code><nowiki>{{Noncanonend}}</nowiki></code> at the end of the segment. Per [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe#Non-canon material|Wookieepedia's Layout Guide]], such material must appear under the article's '''Behind the scenes''' section. Use <code><nowiki>{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}</nowiki></code> for [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] articles.
